end.summary: Practised diversity in Indian languages, food, dress, festivals and music.
end.parentNote: Riya practised explaining how different foods, clothes, languages and celebrations can exist together in India. They used playlists and Diwali examples to connect diversity with unity, and identified a shared seasonal idea across different festivals by the end. Earlier, they mixed up what a “shared thread” means, but clarified it later as a common idea beneath different forms. At home, ask Riya to name two festivals with different customs and one value or idea they share.
